name: paralith-mcp

tools.name: read_state
tools.description: Read any published key of any process, free: /<process>~process@1.0/now/<key>. process is an id or an alias (game, rune, pusd, dao, game-venue, token-venue, earth-token, air-token, fire-token, water-token). Returns null when absent. Common keys: game: player-<address>, catalogref (the catalog's id, not catalog), leaderboard, factions, arenatiers, challenges, economy, economybook, market, markethistory, battlefleet, huntconfig, access. rune and *-token: balance-<address>, tokeninfo (not info), totalsupply. pusd: balance-<address>, bridgeinfo, withdrawals. dao: daoinfo, proposals. game-venue and token-venue: balance-<address>, vaultinfo, vaultpairs.

tools.name: protocol_docs
tools.description: The full protocol documentation as plain text (llms-full.txt), for questions the tools do not answer.

tools.name: game_player
tools.description: Read a Rune Realm player record (yours by default): gold, inventory, companions with energy/happiness/level/moves and pendingMoveOffer, loot boxes, arena record with arena.liveBattle, and liveHunt. Free, unsigned. Call this before deciding anything.

address.description: Another player's AO address; omit for yours.

full.description: Return the raw record instead of the compact view.

tools.name: game_catalog
tools.description: The game rules as data: activity costs/gains, arena terms, element effectiveness, free moves (Rally, Mend), hunt capture odds, items, level-up rules and every move pool. Free, unsigned.

tools.name: game_world
tools.description: Shared world state: access rules, factions, arena difficulty tiers, open PvP challenges and the leaderboard (top 10). Free, unsigned.

tools.name: game_shop_quote
tools.description: The NPC realm shop's current Gold prices (bid/ask) and stock for berries, Scrolls and Rune. Free, unsigned.

tools.name: arena_battle
tools.description: Read a battle: both sides' health, moves with uses left, round number and recent turns. Free. Defaults to your live battle; address reads that player's live battle; battle_id reads one battle directly (finished fights stay readable only briefly).

address.description: Whose live battle; omit for yours.

battle_id.description: A specific battle, e.g. from game_player arena.liveBattle.

full.description: Return the raw record instead of the compact view.

tools.name: hunt_state
tools.description: Read a live hunt run (yours by default): encounter, wild creature, round, status. Free.

address.description: Another player's AO address; omit for yours.

full.description: Return the raw record instead of the compact view.

tools.name: companion_market_browse
tools.description: The companion market (priced in in-game Rune): current listings and recent sales. Free, unsigned.

tools.name: exchange_markets
tools.description: List a venue's markets with lot, tick, taker fee (bps), minimums and status, plus asset denominations. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

tools.name: exchange_book
tools.description: Depth for one market in human units: best bid/ask, top 10 levels each side, price band and today's candle. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

item.description: Base asset, e.g. fire_berry (game) or fire (token).

tools.name: exchange_position
tools.description: Balances at a venue (free, and where each asset sits) with open orders and recent fills, all in human units; yours unless address is given. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

tools.name: bridge_info
tools.description: PUSD bridge configuration and ledger: fees (bps, in/out), supply, reserves per chain and token, the attestor set, and each chain's contract addresses. Free.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Recent PUSD redemptions and their status (pending or released): yours, another address, or all. Free.

address.description: AO address; "all" for every recent redemption.

tools.name: dao_info
tools.description: The DAO's rules and totals: token, admin, proposal threshold and deposit, voting period, quorum/pass/veto (bps), unstake delay, total staked and cooling, open proposals. Free.

tools.name: dao_proposals
tools.description: Open proposals (oldest first) then the last 50 closed ones, with tallies (atomic RUNE), quorum and status (active, passed, rejected, vetoed, failed-quorum, cancelled). Free.

tools.name: dao_stake_info
tools.description: A staker's active and cooling stake, release time, lock time and votes on open proposals; yours unless address is given. Free.

tools.name: vault_list
tools.description: Strategy vaults on a venue (one amm, active and grid per market): status, holdings, locked and burned share with their value and unlock dates, spacing, crank budget. Whole units. Optionally one market. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

item.description: Base asset, e.g. fire_berry or fire.

tools.name: vault_position
tools.description: Vault shares held by an address (yours unless given): shares, unlocked shares, locks with dates, and the value they own in whole units. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show something with the game's and exchange's own visuals, live: battle (follows a player's arena fights, animated), companion (card), hunt, market (order book and chart), vault, position, bridge (transfers). Seeing it is a far better experience than reading about it: call show whenever you do something worth watching. It displays inline where the client supports that, and otherwise (local server) opens in the user's browser. Address defaults to yours.

monster_id.description: companion: which one; omit for the active companion.

battle_id.description: battle: a specific battle, with worker.

worker.description: battle: the battle worker process id.

market.description: market/vault: the market, as exchange_markets lists it.

open.description: Open in the user's browser. Default: only when this client cannot display it inline.

tools.name: progress
tools.description: How an agent is doing, in one free read: game (companion, Gold, Rune, arena record, live battle or hunt), tokens, open orders and vault shares on both venues, pending bridge redemptions, chain gas, and what needs doing next. who: omit for yourself, "all" for every agent set up on this machine, an agent name (claude, codex, grok) or an AO address.

instructions:
This endpoint is READ-ONLY: it explains the protocol and reads live state for any address, free.
To play, trade or bridge, run the local server with a wallet phrase: https://docs.paralithmarkets.com/ai/mcp

Paralith on AO (HyperBEAM): Rune Realm (a companion game), two order books, and the PUSD bridge.
Everything is TEST-prefixed while unreleased. Pass an address wherever a tool takes one.

- Game: game_player (account, companions, live battle or hunt), game_catalog (rules, costs, move stats),
  game_world (factions, arena tiers, open challenges, leaderboard), arena_battle (address or battle_id), hunt_state (address),
  game_shop_quote (NPC shop prices and stock), companion_market_browse (listings and recent sales).
- Markets: exchange_markets / exchange_book / exchange_position on venue "game" (items vs Gold) or "token" (elements vs TEST-RUNE);
  vault_list, vault_position.
- Bridge and DAO: bridge_info, bridge_status, dao_info, dao_proposals, dao_stake_info.
- Anything else: progress (one address across everything), read_state (any published key), protocol_docs.

SHOW IT. Watching beats reading: call show for anything worth seeing (a fight as it happens, a companion, a book, a vault,
a bridge transfer). It displays inline where the client supports it, otherwise it opens in the user's browser.

Docs: https://docs.paralithmarkets.com/llms-full.txt.
